question: Identify the tense in "can also serve as catalysts for mental growth".
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ***Option 1: Simple present***

 
 
• The phrase "can also serve" uses the modal verb **"can"** followed by the base form of the verb **"serve."**
 
• In English grammar, modal verbs like can, may, must, and should are used in the **Simple Present** tense to express current ability, possibility, or general truths.
 
• The sentence describes a general fact or potential that exists in the present regarding digital platforms.
 
 
 
• ***Option 2: Present continuous***
 
 
• This is **incorrect**. The present continuous requires a form of "to be" + verb-ing (e.g., "are serving").
 
 
 
• ***Option 3: Future simple***
 
 
• This is **incorrect**. The future simple typically uses "will" or "shall" + base verb (e.g., "will serve"). While "can" can imply future possibility, it is grammatically categorized as a present modal.
 
 
 
• ***Option 4: Present perfect***
 
 
• This is **incorrect**. The present perfect requires "has/have" + past participle (e.g., "have served").
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Modals and Tense**: Modal verbs do not change their form to show tense in the same way regular verbs do. "Can" is the present form, while "could" is often used as the past or conditional form.
 
• **Function of "Can"**: In this context, "can" indicates **possibility**. It suggests that digital platforms have the potential to act as catalysts, provided the conditions (like being "judiciously curated") are met.
 
• **Catalyst**: A term borrowed from chemistry, used here metaphorically to mean something that precipitates or accelerates an event or change (in this case, mental growth).
